recognize_zh: A 圖在混合發炎細胞背景中有一顆雙核、核仁明顯的大細胞（RS cell，箭頭）；免疫染色中大細胞 CD15、CD30 陽性（B、F），背景大量 CD3 陽性小 T 細胞（E），支持骨髓侵犯的典型何杰金氏淋巴瘤（classical Hodgkin lymphoma）。
features: Panel A (H&E): large binucleate cell with two round nuclei, each with a prominent nucleolus, in a loose background of small lymphocytes and stromal cells (Reed-Sternberg cell)
Panel B: large cell with membranous/Golgi-type CD15 positivity (arrow) among negative small cells
Panel F: weak membranous and paranuclear CD30 staining in a large cell (arrow)
Panel D: CD20 membranous staining in a sheet of cells around the arrowed large cell; tumor-cell positivity is hard to separate from background B cells at this resolution
Panel E: abundant CD3-positive small T cells forming the background infiltrate
Panel C: low Ki-67 index with scattered positive nuclei
describe_en: Composite of bone marrow biopsy H&E and immunohistochemistry. The H&E section (A) shows a large binucleate cell with round nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli, consistent with a Reed-Sternberg cell, set within a background of small lymphocytes and stroma. Immunostains show scattered large cells positive for CD15 (B) and CD30 (F), with a background rich in CD3-positive small T cells (E) and scattered Ki-67-positive nuclei (C); CD20 (D) shows membranous staining in a cellular area around the arrowed large cell, although distinguishing tumor-cell staining from reactive B cells is limited in this image. Given CD30 and CD15 positivity in Reed-Sternberg cells within a T-cell-rich inflammatory background (with PAX5 positivity and CD3/EMA negativity reported), findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by classical Hodgkin lymphoma (stage IV).

ddx.vs: THRLBCL large cells are strongly and uniformly CD20+, CD45+, CD15- and CD30-, whereas classical RS cells are CD30+ CD15+ with weak or absent CD20 and dim PAX5.
ALCL hallmark cells are CD30+ in a strong uniform pattern, often EMA+ and ALK+ with T-cell markers or cytotoxic granules, and PAX5 negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive immunoblasts in the marrow (e.g., viral infection)
ddx.vs: Immunoblasts are CD30 variable but CD15 negative and lack binucleate RS morphology and a clonal context.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei without large inclusion-like nucleoli and are CD61/CD42b positive and CD30/CD15 negative.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD15, CD30, CD20, CD3, Ki-67
